character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A traveler arrives from elsewhere (各) and steps under your roof (宀) as a welcoming guest (客).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un viajero llega de lejos (各) y se cobija bajo tu tejado (宀) recibido como apreciado huésped (客).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 走在济南古城的老街巷中，随处可见驻足流连的游客。他们有的在黑虎泉畔捧起一碗泉水细细品味，有的在垂柳依依的河边静静写生。在这座慢节奏的城市里，每一位远道而来的游人都能找到心灵的寄托。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǒu zài Jǐnán gǔchéng de lǎojiē xiàng zhōng, suíchù kějiàn zhùzú liúlián de yóukè. Tāmen yǒude zài Hēihǔquán pàn pěngqǐ yì wǎn quánshuǐ xìxì pǐnwèi, yǒude zài chuíliǔ yīyī de hébiān jìngjìng xiěshēng. Zài zhè zuò màn jiézòu de chéngshì lǐ, měi yí wèi yuǎndào'érlái de yóurén dōu néng zhǎodào xīnlíng de jìtuō.
extended_reading_passages.en: Walking through Jinan's old alleys, lingered tourists appear everywhere. Some cup bowls of fresh spring water by Black Tiger Spring to savor slowly; others quietly sketch beside weeping willows. In this leisurely city, every traveler finds solace.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los callejones antiguos de Jinan, turistas extasiados pueblan cada rincón. Unos beben agua pura junto al manantial del Tigre Negro; otros dibujan sauces junto al cauce. En esta urbe sosegada, cada visitante forastero halla un remanso de paz.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着全域旅游理念的普及，传统以观光打卡为主的走马观花模式，正加速向深度文化体验转变。现在的游客更看重目的地的历史文脉、特色餐饮与非遗互动，倒逼文旅行业推动产品迭代，提供精细化服务。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe quányù lǚyóu lǐniàn de pǔjí, chuántǒng yǐ guānguāng dǎkǎ wéizhǔ de zǒumǎguānhuā móshì, zhèng jiāsù xiàng shēndù wénhuà tǐyàn zhuǎnbiàn. Xiànzài de yóukè gèng kànzhòng mùdìdì de lìshǐ wénmài, tèsè cānyǐn yǔ fēiyí hùdòng, dàobī wénlǚ hángyè tuīdòng chǎnpǐn diédài, tígōng jīngxìhuà fúwù.
extended_reading_passages.en: As holistic tourism spreads, superficial sightseeing gives way to deep cultural immersion. Modern tourists prioritize heritage, local gastronomy, and craft workshops, prompting tourism operators to iterate products and refine services.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el turismo integral, las visitas superficiales dan paso a la inmersión cultural. El turista actual valora el arraigo histórico, la gastronomía y las tradiciones vivas, forzando al sector a sofisticar sus propuestas y su atención.

meanings_summary.en: to commemorate; to remember; memorial; souvenir
meanings_summary.es: conmemorar; recordar; monumento conmemorativo; recuerdo; suvenir

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Thread your memories into a chronicle (纪) and hold them forever in your heart (念) to commemorate the past.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Teje tus recuerdos en una crónica (纪) y guárdalos en el corazón (念) para conmemorar el pasado.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese ancestral and literary culture, 'jìniàn' links historical recording (纪, the annals of historians) with emotional mindfulness (念, the filial remembrance of ancestors).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual 4th tones: 'jì niàn' (51-51). Pronounce each syllable with sharp, crisp downward pitch without swallowing the second tone.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 纪念 focuses on formal commemoration of significant figures, historical events, or retaining souvenirs for emotional preservation.

contrasts.analysis: 纪念 involves external commemorative acts, monuments, or items (修建纪念馆), whereas 怀念 is an internal, emotional feeling of affectionate nostalgia.
纪念 honors past history, sacrifices, or solemn anniversaries, while 庆祝 rejoices in joyful successes, holidays, or victories with festive cheer.
纪念 applies to broad historical milestones and cultural heroes, whereas 悼念 specifically mourns someone's recent death with solemn grief.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has speech radical 讠 instead of silk radical 纟
Has 工 (work) next to 纟 instead of 己
Has 分 (divide) over 心 instead of 今
Has 刍 (hay) over 心 instead of 今

senses.definition_en: to commemorate; to honor the memory of a person or significant historic event
senses.definition_es: conmemorar; honrar la memoria de una persona o acontecimiento histórico
senses.example_phrase: 纪念先烈 (commemorate martyrs)

senses.definition_en: souvenir; memento; token of remembrance; memorial
senses.definition_es: recuerdo; suvenir; objeto o monumento conmemorativo
senses.example_phrase: 留作纪念 (keep as a souvenir)

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了纪念宋代著名女词人李清照，济南人在趵突泉畔修建了古朴雅致的纪念堂。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile jìniàn Sòngdài zhùmíng nǚ círén Lǐ Qīngzhào, Jǐnán rén zài Bàotūquán pàn xiūjiàn le gǔpǔ yǎzhì de jìniàntáng.
example_sentences.en: To commemorate the renowned Song Dynasty poetess Li Qingzhao, Jinan citizens built an elegant memorial hall beside Baotu Spring.
example_sentences.es: Para conmemorar a la célebre poetisa Li Qingzhao de la dinastía Song, los habitantes erigieron una elegante sala conmemorativa junto al manantial.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在反法西斯战争胜利周年纪念活动中，各国代表向无名英雄纪念碑敬献了花圈。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài fǎnfǎxīsī zhànzhēng shènglì zhōunián jìniàn huódòng zhōng, gèguó dàibiǎo xiàng wúmíng yīngxióng jìniànbēi jìngxiàn le huāquān.
example_sentences.en: In commemorative events marking the victory over fascism, national delegates laid floral wreaths before the Monument to the Unknown Heroes.
example_sentences.es: En los actos conmemorativos de la victoria sobre el fascismo, delegados de diversas naciones ofrendaron coronas florales ante el monumento al héroe anónimo.

idioms.meaning_en: cherish the memory of revolutionary martyrs
immortal; eternal glory through the ages
bear constantly in mind; never forget for a moment
engrave deeply in one's heart; remember forever

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where silk radical 纟 indicates threading threads into an unbroken chronological record.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Weaving fine silk threads (纟) by your own hand (己) to record an enduring historical chronicle (纪).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Hilar seda fina (纟) por uno mismo (己) para tejer una crónica histórica imborrable (纪).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining 今 (present moment) and 心 (heart): holding someone or something in one's heart right now.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: In the present moment (今), keep a cherished loved one held closely inside your heart (心) with love.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: En este mismo instante (今), mantienes a un ser querido presente en tu corazón (心) con devoción.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 细雨中的李清照纪念堂清幽典雅，院落中松柏苍翠，泉水清流。站立在词人雕像前，读着那些婉约深沉的词句，往昔的悲欢离合仿佛随着泉水流淌而来。这一座小小的纪念馆，守护着一座城市永恒的人文记忆。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xìyǔ zhōng de Lǐ Qīngzhào jìniàntáng qīngyōu diǎnyǎ, yuànluò zhōng sōngbǎi cāngcuì, quánshuǐ qīngliú. Zhànlì zài círén diāoxiàng qián, dú zhe nàxiē wǎnyuē shēnchén de cíjù, wǎngxī de bēihuānlíhé fǎngfú suízhe quánshuǐ liútǎng ér lái. Zhè yí zuò xiǎoxiǎo de jìniànguǎn, shǒuhù zhe yí zuò chéngshì yǒnghéng de rénwén jìyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid drizzling rain, Li Qingzhao's memorial hall stands peaceful and elegant, with cypresses and flowing springs. Before the poet's statue, reading her poignant verses, past joys and sorrows drift forward on water. This modest hall guards the city's eternal memory.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo la llovizna, el pabellón conmemorativo de Li Qingzhao luce apacible, flanqueado por cipreses y manantiales. Ante la estatua de la poetisa, sus versos conmovedores reviven nostalgias pasadas, custodiando la memoria humana eterna de la urbe.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 历史文化遗产是活态的国家记忆。在城市更新过程中，建立专题纪念馆并妥善保护历史遗迹，不仅是对先辈奋斗历程的崇高纪念，更是向年轻一代传承历史文脉、激发文化自豪感的重要载体。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lìshǐ wénhuà yíchǎn shì huótài de guójiā jìyì. Zài chéngshì gēngxīn guòchéng zhōng, jiànlì zhuāntí jìniànguǎn bìng tuǒshàn bǎohù lìshǐ yíjì, bùjǐn shì duì xiānbèi fèndòu lìchéng de chónggāo jìniàn, gèng shì xiàng niánqīng yídài chuánchéng lìshǐ wénmài, jīfā wénhuà zìháogǎn de zhòngyào zàitǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Cultural heritage constitutes living national memory. In urban regeneration, creating memorial halls and safeguarding historic remains not only honors ancestral perseverance, but transmits cultural legacy and pride to younger generations.
extended_reading_passages.es: El patrimonio cultural encarna la memoria viva de un pueblo. Erigir museos conmemorativos y proteger vestigios rinde tributo a las generaciones pasadas y transmite el orgullo cultural a los jóvenes como un legado imperecedero.

meanings_summary.en: poem; poetry; verse; poetic sentiment
meanings_summary.es: poema; poesía; verso; sentimiento poético

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Disciplined spoken words (讠) composed in a serene temple (寺) become eternal poetry (诗).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Palabras reflexivas (讠) entonadas en un templo (寺) dan origen a una poesía (诗) sublime.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese literary tradition, 'shī yán zhì' (诗言志 - poetry articulates earnest aspirations). The Shijing (Classic of Poetry) established verse as the highest moral and aesthetic pursuit.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'shī' (55). Keep the vowel elongated and sustained smoothly without dipping or rising.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 诗 denotes rhymed, rhythmic poetic verse and literary imagery expressing intense emotion or thought.

contrasts.analysis: 诗 is rhythmic verse with meter and figurative imagination, whereas 文 refers to general prose, essays, or academic texts.
诗 follows classical poetic meters (like 5-character or 7-character lüshi), while 词 refers specifically to song lyrics set to fixed rhythmic tunes (ci poetry).
诗 is meant for reading, chanting, or reciting, while 歌 is explicitly scored to be sung to musical melody.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has double-person radical 彳 instead of speech radical 讠
Has hand radical 扌 next to 寺
Has cow radical 牛 next to 寺
Has single person radical 亻 next to 寺

senses.definition_en: poetry; a poem; literary composition characterized by rhythm and vivid imagery
senses.definition_es: poema; poesía; composición literaria caracterizada por el ritmo y la emoción lírica
senses.example_phrase: 写一首诗 (write a poem)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对趵突泉奔腾喷涌的壮丽奇观，古往今来的文人留下了无数脍炙人口的赞美诗篇。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì Bàotūquán bēnténg pēnyǒng de zhuànglì qíguān, gǔwǎngjīnlái de wénrén liúxià le wúshù kuàizhìrénkǒu de zànměi shīpiān.
example_sentences.en: Confronted with the magnificent spectacle of Baotu Spring surging forth, literati through the ages left behind countless celebrated poems of praise.
example_sentences.es: Ante el prodigioso e impetuoso borbotar del manantial Baotu, literatos de todas las épocas compusieron innumerables poemas célebres de alabanza.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在现代文学创作研讨会上，青年学者深入探讨了古代山水诗在当代生态文明理念中的美学价值。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàndài wénxué chuàngzuò yántǎohuì shàng, qīngnián xuézhě shēnrù tàntǎo le gǔdài shānshuǐ shī zài dāngdài shēngtài wénmíng lǐniàn zhōng de měixué jiàzhí.
example_sentences.en: At the contemporary literature symposium, young scholars explored the aesthetic value of classical landscape poetry within modern ecological values.
example_sentences.es: En el simposio literario contemporáneo, jóvenes investigadores debatieron el valor estético de la poesía paisajística clásica en la conciencia ecológica actual.

idioms.meaning_en: idyllic and picturesque; poetic feelings and artistic mood
compose poems with spear poised; romantic heroism in war
Du Fu's poetry and Han Yu's prose; superlative literary style
rack one's brains to write verse

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where speech radical 讠 signifies expressed words, and 寺 implies disciplined measure and rhythm.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Elevated spoken words (讠) uttered in a quiet mountain temple (寺) transform into timeless poetry (诗).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras recitadas (讠) con veneración en el templo (寺) se transforman en poesía inmortal (诗).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南的泉水是流淌在青石街巷间的无声诗篇。每一朵跃起的水花，每一片漂浮的绿藻，都仿佛带着千年前文人的墨香与情怀。若在清晨漫步泉边，心中自会涌现出超然脱俗的诗意。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán de quánshuǐ shì liútǎng zài qīngshí jiēxiàng jiān de wúshēng shīpiān. Měi yì duǒ yuèqǐ de shuǐhuā, měi yí piàn piāofú de lǜzǎo, dōu fǎngfú dài zhe qiānnián qián wénrén de mòxiāng yǔ qínghuái. Ruò zài qīngchén mànbù quánbiān, xīnzhōng zì huì yǒngxiàn chū chāorán tuōsú de shīyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Jinan's springs are silent poems flowing between green cobblestones. Every leaping water droplet and floating waterweed carries the fragrance of ink from poets centuries ago. Strolling by the spring at dawn, pure poetic sentiment wells up within.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los manantiales de Jinan son poesías mudas que surcan adoquines históricos. Cada gota que salta y cada alga que flota conservan el eco literario de poetas remotos. Caminar a orillas del venero al amanecer despierta una inspiración lírica pura.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古典山水诗不仅是文学艺术的瑰宝，更是人与自然和谐共生哲学思想的生动体现。现代生态文明建设从古代山水诗中汲取审美智慧，倡导尊重自然、保护水系，实现人与环境的诗意栖居。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdiǎn shānshuǐ shī bùjǐn shì wénxué yìshù de guībǎo, gèng shì rén yǔ zìrán héxié gòngshēng zhéxué sīxiǎng de shēngdòng tǐxiàn. Xiàndài shēngtài wénmíng jiànshè cóng gǔdài shānshuǐ shī zhōng xīqǔ shěnměi zhìhuì, chàngdǎo zūnzhòng zìrán, bǎohù shuǐxì, shíxiàn rén yǔ huánjìng de shīyì qījū.
extended_reading_passages.en: Classical landscape poetry is not only an artistic treasure, but a vivid testament to harmony between humanity and nature. Modern ecological planning draws aesthetic wisdom from ancient poems to foster poetic dwelling.
extended_reading_passages.es: La poesía paisajística clásica es una joya artística y reflejo vivo de la comunión entre el ser humano y la naturaleza. El ecologismo moderno bebe de su sabiduría estética para promover la armonía ambiental y el hábitat poético.

meanings_summary.en: author; writer; creator (of a work)
meanings_summary.es: autor; escritor; creador (de una obra)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A person (亻) who begins to write (作) and works under the sun (者) is an author who creates lasting works.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una persona (亻) que compone (作) de sol a sol (者) es el autor de obras perdurables.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The morpheme 'zuò' (creating, inventing ex nihilo) coupled with 'zhě' (agent suffix) forms the classical concept of literary authorship distinct from mere copyists (述者).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'zuò' (51) followed by dipping 3rd tone 'zhě' (214). Maintain crisp, distinct contours.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 作者 is a general noun denoting the creator, writer, or intellectual originator of books, articles, or artistic creations.

contrasts.analysis: 作者 refers specifically to the creator of a particular text or book, whereas 作家 denotes a professional novelist, essayist, or literary writer by career.
作者 creates original literary or scholarly works, while 记者 is a journalist who reports and interviews for news media.
作者 is the creator of the written work, whereas 读者 is the audience/consumer who reads it (the complementary antonym).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has sun radical 日 on the left instead of person radical 亻
Has speech radical 讠 instead of person radical 亻
Has 匕 at base instead of 日 in 者
Has 丂 at base instead of 日 in 者

senses.definition_en: the creator, writer, or originator of a literary, scholarly, or artistic work
senses.definition_es: persona que crea, escribe o compone una obra literaria, artística o científica; autor
senses.example_phrase: 本书作者 (author of this book)

example_sentences.hanzi: 文章作者用细腻生动的笔触，描绘了济南清泉在四季变换中呈现的绝妙景致。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wénzhāng zuòzhě yòng xìnì shēngdòng de bǐchù, miáohuì le Jǐnán qīngquán zài sìjì biànhuàn zhōng chéngxiàn de juémiào jǐngzhì.
example_sentences.en: The author of the essay employed delicate, vivid brushwork to depict the exquisite scenes of Jinan's clear springs through the seasons.
example_sentences.es: El autor del ensayo empleó pinceladas vívidas y delicadas para retratar las maravillosas estampas de los manantiales de Jinan en cada estación.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在新书发布会上，作者与现场读者围绕传统文化在数字时代的创新传承展开了深入交流。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài xīnshū fābùhuì shàng, zuòzhě yǔ xiànchǎng dúzhě wéirào chuántǒng wénhuà zài shùzì shídài de chuàngxīn chuánchéng zhǎnkāi le shēnrù jiāoliú.
example_sentences.en: At the book launch, the author engaged in a deep dialogue with readers on the innovative transmission of heritage in the digital era.
example_sentences.es: En la presentación del libro, el autor dialogó profundamente con los lectores sobre la preservación innovadora de la cultura tradicional en la era digital.

idioms.meaning_en: suffer the consequences of one's own actions
the creator of an evil precedent; the initiator of a bad trend
transmit tradition without inventing new theories
not shrink from doing what is right; take responsibility proactively

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where person radical 亻 signifies human labor and craftsmanship starting (乍) something into being.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A creative person (亻) suddenly (乍) begins to craft, producing an original masterpiece of literature (作).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona (亻) inspirada comienza de repente (乍) a crear una obra literaria original (作).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient compound depicting an elder 耂 passing down discourse and teachings 日; functions as a nominal agent suffix.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A dedicated scholar with wisdom (耂) sits from sunrise to sunset (日) composing books as a master writer (者).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un sabio estudioso (耂) pasa de sol a sol (日) escribiendo crónicas como respetado autor (者).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 优秀的散文作者往往具有敏锐的观察力。老舍先生笔下的济南泉水，既有北方汉子的豪爽奔放，又有江南女子的温婉柔媚。透过作者饱含深情的文字，那喷涌的泉水仿佛直接跃入读者的心底。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yōuxiù de sǎnwén zuòzhě wǎngwǎng jùyǒu mǐnruì de guānchálì. Lǎo Shě xiānsheng bǐxià de Jǐnán quánshuǐ, jì yǒu běifāng hànzi de háoshuǎng bēnfàng, yòu yǒu jiāngnán nǚzǐ de wēnwǎn róumèi. Tòuguò zuòzhě bǎohán shēnqíng de wénzì, nà pēnyǒng de quánshuǐ fǎngfú zhíjiē yuè rù dúzhě de xīndǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Outstanding essayists possess keen perception. In Lao She's prose, Jinan's springs embody both northern vigor and southern gentleness. Through the author's affectionate words, bubbling waters leap into the reader's heart.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los ensayistas notables poseen una mirada perspicaz. Bajo la pluma de Lao She, los manantiales de Jinan aúnan el brío norteño y la dulzura sureña. Con su afectuosa prosa, el borbotar del agua conmueve directamente al lector.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在知识产权保护日益受到重视的今天，维护学术论文与文艺作品作者的合法权益，是繁荣文化创新的制度保障。只有建立健全版权保护体系，尊重原创作者的智力劳动，才能持续激发全社会的创造活力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài zhīshi chǎnquán bǎohù rìyì shòudào zhòngshì de jīntiān, wéihù xuéshù lùnwén yǔ wényì zuòpǐn zuòzhě de héfǎ quányì, shì fánróng wénhuà chuàngxīn de zhìdù bǎozhàng. Zhǐyǒu jiànlì jiànquán bǎnquán bǎohù tǐxì, zūnzhòng yuánchuàng zuòzhě de zhìlì láodòng, cáinéng chíxù jīfā quán shèhuì de chuàngzào huólì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Today, protecting the rights of authors of academic papers and artistic creations is essential to cultural flourishing. Only sound copyright regimes and respect for intellectual labor can sustain societal creative vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: Proteger los legítimos derechos de los autores de obras artísticas y académicas resulta crucial para el florecimiento cultural. Solo una sólida tutela del derecho de autor estimulará permanentemente el ingenio creador colectivo.

meanings_summary.en: to feel; to perceive; to sense; feeling; sensation; impression
meanings_summary.es: sentir; percibir; tener la sensación de; sensación; impresión; percepción

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When your heart stirs with emotion (感) and your eyes awaken to see (觉), you achieve true feeling and perception.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando el corazón se emociona (感) y los ojos despiertan (觉), alcanzas la percepción sensorial plena.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese epistemology considers 'gǎn' (visceral emotional responsiveness) and 'jué' (rational cognitive waking) as two halves of human consciousness.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'gǎn' (214) followed by rising 2nd tone 'jué' (35). In the polyphone 睡觉 (sleep), 觉 shifts to 'jiào' (51).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 感觉 denotes general sensory perception, bodily sensations, or subjective intuitive impressions.

contrasts.analysis: 感觉 can serve as both a noun (a physical sensation/feeling) and a verb, whereas 觉得 is strictly a verb expressing subjective opinion or mental assessment.
感觉 highlights immediate sensory inputs or intuitive impressions, while 感受 denotes deeper, lasting psychological experiences or reflections.
感觉 is everyday language for feelings, whereas 感知 is a formal cognitive, psychological, or robotic terminology for perceptual processing.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 或 (or) over 心 instead of 咸 in 感
Has 儿 (legs) at the bottom instead of 见 in 觉
Has 巾 (cloth) at base instead of 见
Has 土 (earth) at base instead of 见

senses.definition_en: to become aware of through bodily senses or intuition; to feel; to think that
senses.definition_es: sentir; percibir mediante los sentidos o la intuición; creer
senses.example_phrase: 感觉泉水很凉 (feel that the spring water is cold)

senses.definition_en: physical sensation; intuitive impression or feeling
senses.definition_es: sensación física; impresión o sentimiento intuitivo
senses.example_phrase: 给人一种清新的感觉 (give people a fresh feeling)

example_sentences.hanzi: 走在绿树成荫的泉池小径上，微风伴着湿润水汽拂面而来，让人感觉格外清爽舒畅。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zǒu zài lǜshù chéngyīn de quánchí xiǎojìng shàng, wēifēng bàn zhe shīrùn shuǐqì fúmiàn ér lái, ràng rén gǎnjué géwài qīngshuǎng shūchàng.
example_sentences.en: Walking along the shaded path by the spring pool, a light breeze bringing moist vapor brushes past, making one feel exceptionally refreshed.
example_sentences.es: Al caminar por el sendero arbolado junto al manantial, la suave brisa húmeda acaricia el rostro, transmitiendo un frescor sumamente gratificante.

example_sentences.hanzi: 市场调查表明，消费者对该品牌新一代智能产品的交互体验感觉良好，回购意愿显著高于竞品。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shìchǎng diàochá biǎomíng, xiāofèizhě duì gāi pǐnpái xīn yídài zhìnéng chǎnpǐn de jiāohù tǐyàn gǎnjué liánghǎo, huígòu yìyuàn xiǎnzhù gāoyú jìngpǐn.
example_sentences.en: Market surveys show consumers feel very positive toward the interactive experience of the smart product, showing higher repurchase intent than competitors.
example_sentences.es: Los estudios de mercado reflejan que los consumidores sienten una excelente impresión con la interfaz inteligente, mostrando una intención de recompra muy superior.

idioms.meaning_en: of one's own free will; voluntary
restless; feeling agitated and unsettled
feel as if experiencing it personally; deep empathy
sensory numbness; devoid of acute awareness

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining 咸 (all people united in reaction) over 心 (heart): universal inner stirring of feelings.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When an outside stimulus touches everyone (咸), deep emotional ripples stir in the heart (心) as a genuine feeling (感).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cuando un estímulo conmueve a todos (咸), brota en el corazón (心) un sentimiento y emoción (感) auténtico.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining learning/enlightenment over 见 (seeing): cognitive illumination where one becomes aware.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: After long contemplation, opening your eyes to see (见) clearly brings sudden awareness (觉) and understanding.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tras la reflexión, abres los ojos y ves (见) con claridad, alcanzando la plena percepción y despertar (觉).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 坐在清澈的泉水池旁，把手指轻轻浸入清凉甘洌的泉流中，那一瞬间的冰爽感觉直抵心脾。城市喧嚣的浮躁仿佛被这股灵动的清流彻底洗净，只留下一份返璞归真的舒畅与宁谧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zuò zài qīngchè de quánshuǐ chí páng, bǎ shǒuzhǐ qīngqīng jìnrù qīngliáng gānliè de quánliú zhōng, nà yì súnjiān de bīngshuǎng gǎnjué zhídǐ xīnpí. Chéngshì xuānxiāo de fúzào fǎngfú bèi zhè gǔ língdòng de qīngliú chèdǐ xǐjìng, zhǐ liúxià yí fèn fǎnpúguīzhēn de shūchàng yǔ níngmì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Sitting beside the clear spring pool and gently dipping fingers into cool, sweet currents, the instant refreshing chill penetrates the soul. City vanity feels thoroughly cleansed by this fluid stream, leaving tranquil simplicity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Sentado junto al manantial, sumergir los dedos en el agua fresca produce una sensación reconfortante que sosiega el alma. El bullicio urbano queda purificado por la corriente, devolviendo una paz diáfana y serena.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在智能座舱人机交互设计中，如何提升驾驶者的舒适感觉与沉浸式体验是各大汽车厂商竞争的焦点。研发团队通过优化座椅人体工学曲线与环绕降噪系统，为用户营造出全方位的品质感与安全感。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài zhìnéng zuòcāng rénjī jiāohù shèjì zhōng, rúhé tíshēng jiàshǐzhě de shūshì gǎnjué yǔ chénjìnxìng tǐyàn shì gè dà qìchē chǎngshāng jìngzhēng de jiāodiǎn. Yánfā tuánduì tōngguò yōuhuà zuòyǐ réntǐ gōngxué qūxiàn yǔ huánrào jiàngzào xìtǒng, wèi yònghù yíngzào chū quánfāngwèi de pǐnzhìgǎn yǔ ānquángǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In intelligent cabin HMI design, elevating drivers' comfort sensations and immersive experience is a competitive focus. Teams refine ergonomic curves and acoustic damping to deliver a comprehensive sense of quality and security.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el diseño de cabinas inteligentes, optimizar la sensación de confort y la inmersión del conductor es clave competitiva. Los equipos perfeccionan la ergonomía y la insonorización para brindar máxima calidad y seguridad.

meanings_summary.en: limpid; crystal-clear; pure and transparent (of water or eyes)
meanings_summary.es: límpido; cristalino; transparente; diáfano (referido al agua o la mirada)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Pure spring water (清) so transparent that sunlight penetrates through (澈) to the stony bottom.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Agua pura de manantial (清) tan transparente que la luz penetra (澈) hasta el fondo rocoso.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese aesthetic and moral traditions, water clarity ('qīngchè') is the supreme metaphor for incorruptible moral integrity and enlightened mental purity (心境清澈).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'qīng' (55) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'chè' (51). Clear pitch separation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 清澈 specifically describes liquids (especially springs, rivers, lakes) or eyes that are transparent, luminous, and free of sediment.

contrasts.analysis: 清澈 describes optical transparency in water or eyes, whereas 清洁 means clean, sanitary, or washed free of dirt/bacteria.
清澈 refers to transparent optical clarity, while 清新 refers to fresh, invigorating air, breeze, or artistic styles.
清澈 is an adjective depicting existing visual transparency, whereas 澄清 can function as an active verb meaning to clarify misunderstandings or let sediment settle.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has sun radical 日 on the left instead of water 氵
Has heart radical 忄 on the left instead of water 氵
Has hand radical 扌 instead of water radical 氵
Has vehicle radical 车 instead of water radical 氵

senses.definition_en: limpid; crystal-clear; completely transparent and free from impurities
senses.definition_es: límpido; cristalino; transparente y exento de impurezas
senses.example_phrase: 清澈见底的泉水 (crystal-clear spring water through which the bottom is visible)

example_sentences.hanzi: 济南的泉水清澈见底，池底游动的水草与彩色游鱼在日光折射下历历在目。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán de quánshuǐ qīngchè jiàndǐ, chídǐ yóudòng de shuǐcǎo yǔ cǎisè yóuyú zài rìguāng zhéshè xià lìlì zài mù.
example_sentences.en: Jinan's springs are crystal-clear to the bottom; floating weeds and colorful swimming fish are clearly visible under sunlight.
example_sentences.es: Las aguas de los manantiales de Jinan son límpidas como el cristal; la vegetación y los peces de colores se distinguen con nitidez bajo el sol.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过多年流域综合治理，原本受到工业污染的护城河重现清澈，两岸生态环境显著改善。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián liùyù zōnghé zhìlǐ, yuánběn shòudào gōngyè wūrǎn de hùchénghé chóngxiàn qīngchè, liǎng'àn shēngtài huánjìng xiǎnzhù gǎishàn.
example_sentences.en: After years of integrated basin management, the moat once plagued by industrial pollution has regained crystal clarity.
example_sentences.es: Tras años de saneamiento integral, el foso perimetral antes afectado por vertidos industriales luce de nuevo cristalino y restaurado.

idioms.meaning_en: when water is clear, stones appear; the truth comes to light
crystal-clear down to the bottom; completely transparent
the seas are calm and the Yellow River is clear; peace under heaven
as distinct as the waters of Jing and Wei rivers; clear distinction

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where water radical 氵 indicates liquid, and 青 denotes vibrant purity of verdant spring growth.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Pure water droplets (氵) sparkling like green jade (青) in spring sunlight show supreme clarity (清).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Gotas de agua pura (氵) que brillan como jade verde (青) al sol revelan una transparencia pura (清).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where water radical 氵 combines with 徹 (penetrate through) to express seeing straight through water.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Flowing water (氵) so sheer and luminous that sunlight penetrates completely through to the rocks beneath (澈).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Agua cristalina (氵) tan diáfana que los rayos del sol penetran hasta el lecho rocoso (澈).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 趵突泉的泉水清澈明亮，宛如一块巨大的无瑕碧玉。微风拂过水面，泛起细碎的涟漪，池底的水藻如青丝般轻柔摇曳。静静注视着这泓清澈泉流，尘世间的纷扰喧嚣瞬间消散，心境亦随之变得澄明安宁。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bàotūquán de quánshuǐ qīngchè míngliàng, wǎnrú yí kuài jùdà de wúxiá bìyù. Wēifēng fúguò shuǐmiàn, fànqǐ xìsuì de liányī, chídǐ de shuǐzǎo rú qīngsī bān qīngróu yáoyè. Jìngjìng zhùshì zhe zhè hóng qīngchè quánliú, chénshì jiān de fēnrǎo xuānnào shùnjiān xiāosàn, xīnjìng yì suízhī biànde chéngmíng ānníng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Baotu Spring's water is crystal-clear and bright, like a giant flawless emerald. A gentle breeze creates delicate ripples as underwater grasses sway softly. Gazing quietly into this limpid spring, worldly distractions vanish, leaving serene clarity.
extended_reading_passages.es: El agua del manantial Baotu es cristalina y brillante cual esmeralda perfecta. La brisa riza el agua mientras las algas ondean con gracilidad. Contemplar este remanso diáfano disuelve toda inquietud, dejando una serenidad límpida en el alma.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 生态环境治理的核心目标之一是重现江河湖泊的清澈底色。近年来，环保部门全面推行河长制，强化源头截污与水体自净功能修复。水体透明度显著提高，不仅改善了人居环境，更重塑了城市的水系生态安全屏障。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēngtài huánjìng zhìlǐ de héxīn mùbiāo zhīyī shì chóngxiàn jiānghé húpō de qīngchè dǐsè. Jìnniánlái, huánbǎo bùmén quánmiàn tuīxíng hézhǎngzhì, qiánghuà yuántóu jiéwū yǔ shuǐtǐ zìjìng gōngnéng xiūfù. Shuǐtǐ tòumíngdù xiǎnzhù tígāo, bùjǐn gǎishàn le rénjū huánjìng, gèng zhòngshù le chéngshì de shuǐxì shēngtài ānquán píngzhàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: A central goal of environmental management is restoring rivers and lakes to pristine clarity. Implementing the "River Chief" mechanism strengthens pollution interception and ecological self-purification, safeguarding urban water ecology.
extended_reading_passages.es: Un objetivo primordial de la política ambiental es recuperar la transparencia límpida de los cursos de agua. Con la tutela de cuencas y el saneamiento fluvial, la transparencia acuática mejora el hábitat y blinda el ecosistema urbano.

meanings_summary.en: to see the bottom (water is clear); to bottom out; to be exhausted / depleted
meanings_summary.es: verse el fondo (agua transparente); tocar fondo; agotarse; vaciarse

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Look with clear eyes (见) straight through transparent waters to glimpse the rocky bottom (底).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Abre bien los ojos (见) a través del agua diáfana para divisar con nitidez el fondo (底).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The visual clarity of water reaching the bottom ('jiàndǐ') serves as a metaphor in Chinese thought for transparency in governance, honest character, and financial reserves.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'jiàn' (51) followed by dipping 3rd tone 'dǐ' (214). Pronounce each syllable distinctly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 见底 literally describes transparent water where the substrate is visible, or figuratively denotes reaching empty reserves.

contrasts.analysis: 见底 describes seeing the bottom of water or depleting stocks, whereas 见方 is a mathematical/spatial measure of square dimensions (一米见方).
见底 refers to visual depth or reaching the end of supplies, while 见效 means to produce a noticeable positive medical or policy effect.
见底 relates to physical depth and exhaustion, while 见识 refers to worldly experience, broad knowledge, and erudition.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has a horizontal stroke inside instead of open legs in 见
Has person radical 亻 next to 氐 instead of shelter 广
Has silk radical 纟 next to 氏
Has 占 under 广 instead of 氐 in 底

senses.definition_en: to be so transparent that the bottom is clearly visible
senses.definition_es: ser tan transparente que se ve el fondo
senses.example_phrase: 清澈见底 (limpid and clear down to the bottom)

senses.definition_en: to touch bottom; to be nearly exhausted or empty (of funds, stock, or supplies)
senses.definition_es: tocar fondo; agotarse; estar a punto de acabarse
senses.example_phrase: 存粮见底 (grain reserves hit the bottom)

example_sentences.hanzi: 济南的许多泉池清澈见底，游鱼在青翠的水草间穿梭游弋，令人赏心悦目。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán de xǔduō quánchí qīngchè jiàndǐ, yóuyú zài qīngcuì de shuǐcǎo jiān chuānsuō yóuyì, lìngrén shǎngxīnyùmù.
example_sentences.en: Many spring pools in Jinan are crystal-clear to the bottom, with swimming fish weaving between verdant waterweeds, delighting the senses.
example_sentences.es: Muchos estanques de manantiales en Jinan son tan límpidos que se ve el fondo; los peces nadan entre algas verdes, deleitando la vista.

example_sentences.hanzi: 由于持续干旱和夏季灌溉用水骤增，该地区多座小型水库的蓄水池已然接近见底。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chíxù gānhàn hé xiàjì guàngài yòngshuǐ zhòuzēng, gāi dìqū duō zuò xiǎoxíng shuǐkù de xùshuǐchí yǐrán jiējìn jiàndǐ.
example_sentences.en: Due to prolonged drought and soaring summer irrigation demand, several small reservoirs in the region are nearing depletion.
example_sentences.es: Por la sequía prolongada y el súbito aumento de riego veraniego, varios embalses de la comarca están casi vacíos y tocan fondo.

inquire deeply into the root; get to the bottom of things

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram depicting an oversized human eye (目) atop walking legs (儿), emphasizing active optical perception.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person walking on legs (儿) opens wide eyes to clearly see (见) the submerged pebbles.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona que camina sobre sus piernas (儿) abre los ojos para ver (见) las piedras del fondo.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining shelter 广 and low base 氐, denoting the foundational bedrock or lowest interior surface.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under the broad shelter (广), reach down to touch the lowest bedrock foundation or bottom (底).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el amplio alero (广), extiendes la mano hasta palpar la base más profunda o fondo (底).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫步在趵突泉池畔，最引人赞叹的莫过于那一池见底的碧波。泉水澄清透明，池底细腻的沙石与摇曳的水草清晰可见，游鱼仿佛悬浮在空中自由游动，为古城平添了几分出尘的灵气。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànbù zài Bàotūquán chí pàn, zuì yǐnrén zàntàn de mòguòyú nà yì chí jiàndǐ de bìbō. Quánshuǐ chéngqīng tòumíng, chídǐ xìnì de shāshí yǔ yáoyè de shuǐcǎo qīngxī kějiàn, yóuyú fǎngfú xuánfú zài kōngzhōng zìyóu yóudòng, wèi gǔchéng píngtiān le jǐ fèn chūchén de língqì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Strolling by Baotu Spring, what amazes most is the green pool visible to the bottom. Water is so transparent that fine pebbles and swaying weeds appear clearly; swimming fish seem suspended in midair, gracing the city with ethereal charm.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al pasear junto al manantial Baotu, admira un remanso tan diáfano que se ve el fondo. La arena fina y las algas se distinguen nítidas; los peces parecen flotar en el aire, dotando a la urbe de una mágica espiritualidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 水资源预警机制在极端干旱应对中起着关键作用。水务调度中心通过实时传感器监测各大地下水库的水位变化，一旦监测指标接近见底红线，便立即启动跨区域应急调水方案，确保居民饮水安全。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shuǐ zīyuán yùjǐng jīzhì zài jíduān gānhàn yīngduì zhōng qǐ zhe guānjiàn zuòyòng. Shuǐwù diàodù zhōngxīn tōngguò shíshí chuángǎnqì jiāncè gè dà dìxià shuǐkù de shuǐwèi biànhuà, yídàn jiāncè zhǐbiāo jiējìn jiàndǐ hóngxiàn, biàn lìjí qǐdòng kuà qūyù yìngjí diàoshuǐ fāng'àn, quèbǎo jūmín yǐnshuǐ ānquán.
extended_reading_passages.en: Early-warning mechanisms are crucial when confronting severe droughts. The dispatch center monitors water tables via sensors; should indicators approach the depletion threshold, emergency diversions activate to safeguard municipal supplies.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las alertas tempranas son vitales frente a sequías extremas. Los sensores miden los acuíferos subterráneos; si los niveles se aproximan al umbral crítico de agotamiento, se trasvasa agua de emergencia para asegurar el consumo humano.

meanings_summary.en: classifier for streams, gushes, smells, forces, or passions; share; stock; thigh
meanings_summary.es: clasificador para chorros, corrientes, tufos, fuerzas o impulsos; acción (bursátil); muslo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Muscular strength (月) driving an energetic thrust (殳) creates a powerful gushing stream or surge of power (股).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La fuerza muscular (月) que propulsa una vara (殳) genera un potente chorro de agua o impulso (股).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originally the anatomic thigh ('thigh bone/muscle'), 'gǔ' metonymically extended to woven strands of rope (股线), and hence to classifiers for braided streams, smells, and financial portions (股份).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'gǔ' (214). In 'yì gǔ' (一股), 'yī' shifts to 4th tone: 'yì gǔ' (51-214).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 股 acts as a measure word for dynamic streams, gushes of liquid, gusts of air/odor, surges of emotion, or financial shares.

contrasts.analysis: 股 classifies dynamic streams, surges, odors, or forces (一股泉水, 一股力量), whereas 条 classifies long, static, linear physical items (一条河, 一条绳子).
股 emphasizes burst, flow, or intangible sensation (一股清香), while 道 classifies flashes of light, cracks, mountain ridges, or orders (一道闪电, 一道道伤疤).
股 denotes fluid streams or olfactory puffs, whereas 束 classifies bundled solid items or bundled light beams (一束光, 一束花).

extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bàotūquán chí zhōngyāng nà sān gǔ bēnyǒng bùxī de dà quán, shì Jǐnán chéng tiàodòng bùxiū de xīnmài. Xuěbái de shuǐhuā zì quándǐ fāngǔn ér chū, rútóng sān duī duījī búsàn de suìyù. Shuǐqì mímàn zài qīngshí lángān páng, dàilái yì gǔ qìnrénxīnpí de qīngliáng, lìngrén liúliánwǎnfǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: The three tirelessly surging streams in the center of Baotu Spring are Jinan's pulsing heartbeat. Snow-white plumes churn from the deep like mounds of jade. Vapor drifts past balustrades, bringing a refreshing chill that captivates.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los tres vigorosos chorros perennes del manantial Baotu son el latido vital de Jinan. Espumas blancas borbotan desde el fondo como pilas de jade. El vapor flota junto a la balaustrada trayendo un frescor reconfortante que fascina.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 资本市场中股票发行机制的改革深化，为高精尖制造企业提供了源源不断的资金支持。通过设立科创板，一大批拥有核心专利的技术创新团队成功上市发行股份，为实体经济高质量转型注入了强劲动力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zīběn shìchǎng zhōng gǔpiào fāxíng jīzhì de gǎigé shēnhuà, wèi gāojīngjiān zhìzào qǐyè tígōng le yuányuánbùduàn de zījīn zhīchí. Tōngguò shèlì kēchuàngbǎn, yí dà pī yōngyǒu héxīn zhuānlì de jìshù chuàngxīn tuánduì chénggōng shàngshì fāxíng gǔfèn, wèi shítǐ jīngjì gāozhìliàng zhuǎnxíng zhùrù le qiángjìn dònglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Deepening equity issuance reforms provide continuous capital for cutting-edge manufacturers. Through the STAR Market, innovation teams possessing patents successfully float shares, infusing physical manufacturing with robust momentum.
extended_reading_passages.es: Las reformas bursátiles inyectan capital continuo a la manufactura de vanguardia. Gracias al mercado de innovación, empresas con patentes exclusivas emiten acciones con éxito, impulsando con vigor la economía real y productiva.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 喷 stresses the forceful, directional ejection of liquid, vapor, or particles from a narrow outlet under internal pressure.

contrasts.analysis: 喷 denotes forceful vertical or horizontal jetting under pressure, while 涌 emphasizes upward welling, bubbling, or continuous surging from below.
喷 shoots liquid out forcefully in a pressurized stream, whereas 洒 means to scatter or sprinkle droplets loosely over an area.
喷 involves continuous high-pressure ejection, while 滴 denotes falling drop by drop in discrete, tiny amounts.

extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǒujìn míngquán chí pàn, biàn néng tīngjiàn nà qīngcuì yuè'ěr de quánshēng. Sān gǔ zhǔquán pēnyǒng rú fèi, jīdàng qǐ tuántuán xuěbái jīngyíng de shuǐhuā. extended_reading_passages.en: Nearing the spring pool, one hears crisp, melodious splashes. The three main springs spout as if boiling, churning snow-white droplets. Under sunlight, fine spray transforms into a rainbow mist, creating an enchanting wonderland.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al acercarse al manantial, se escucha el chapoteo cantarín del agua. Tres veneros brotan como agua en ebullición, levantando espumas blancas. Bajo el sol, las gotas pulverizadas forman una niebla irisada de ensueño.

extended_reading_passages.en: In modern demonstration agro-parks, automated fertigation sprinkler systems are widely used. The central system adjusts nozzle pressure and spray coverage based on soil sensors, delivering precision hydration.
extended_reading_passages.es: En parques agrícolas de vanguardia, los aspersores inteligentes de fertirriego se aplican ampliamente. El sistema central regula la presión y el alcance según la humedad del suelo, optimizando el agua de regadío.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 高低 forms an antonymous nominal compound denoting the physical height continuum, relative skill/quality rank, or acoustic pitch.

contrasts.analysis: 高低 emphasizes relative comparison or uneven variance (高低不平, 分高低), while 高度 is a precise quantitative measurement of elevation or degree of achievement.
高低 can describe physical height, pitch, or skill, whereas 优劣 is strictly evaluative of qualitative superiority versus inferiority.
高低 denotes static or dynamic height differences, while 起伏 emphasizes the undulating wave-like motion or fluctuating fortunes over time.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南地势南高北低，南部群山起伏，为泉水蓄积了丰沛的地下水源。漫步在古城中，随处可见高低错落的青石台阶与依势而建的泉池。泉水从高处的岩隙汩汩流下，顺着水道汇入低处的池塘，宛如一曲自然的乐章。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán dìshì nán gāo běi dī, nánbù qúnshān qǐfú, wèi quánshuǐ xùjī le fēngpèi de dìxià shuǐyuán. Mànbù zài gǔchéng zhōng, suíchù kějiàn gāodī cuòluò de qīngshí táijiē yǔ yī shì ér jiàn de quánchí. Quánshuǐ cóng gāochù de yánxì gǔgǔ liúxià, shùn zhe shuǐdào huìrù dīchù de chítáng, wǎnrú yì qǔ zìrán de yuèzhāng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Jinan's topography slopes from high south to low north, with southern hills storing groundwater. Walking through the city, uneven stone steps and stepped pools appear everywhere. Springs murmur down from rock clefts into lower ponds like natural music.
extended_reading_passages.es: La orografía de Jinan desciende de sur a norte; los montes sureños recargan los acuíferos. Escalones de piedra y estanques escalonados salpican el casco histórico; el agua cae desde las hendiduras hacia los remansos bajos con cadencia musical.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在工业自动化产线中，激光测距传感器对工件表面高低平整度的检测精度达到了微米级。控制系统能实时识别微小的表面高低起伏与凹凸瑕疵，确保精密机械零部件在严苛工况下的装配精度与耐久性能。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gōngyè zìdònghuà chǎnxiàn zhōng, jīguāng cèjù chuángǎnqì duì gōngjiàn biǎomiàn gāodī píngzhěngdù de jiǎncè jīngdù dádào le wēimǐ jí. Kòngzhì xìtǒng néng shíshí shíbié wēixiǎo de biǎomiàn gāodī qǐfú yǔ āotū xiácī, quèbǎo jīngmì jīxiè língbùjiàn zài yánkē gōngkuàng xià de zhuāngpèi jīngdù yǔ nàijiǔ xìngnéng.
extended_reading_passages.en: On automated production lines, laser sensors measure workpiece flatness and elevation down to microns. The system detects tiny surface undulations and convex/concave defects in real time, securing precision assembly under tough conditions.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las líneas automatizadas, sensores láser miden desniveles y planitudes con precisión micrométrica. El sistema detecta diminutas ondulaciones y relieves para garantizar el ensamblaje exacto de piezas mecánicas críticas.

mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical rhetoric, 'shèn' denotes supreme degree, and 'zhì' denotes reaching the outer spatial/conceptual boundary; combined, they mark an unexpected escalation of reality.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual 4th tones: 'shèn zhì' (51-51). Both syllables drop sharply and decisively; keep the transition tight and forceful.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 甚至 acts as an escalating connective conjunction or adverb introducing a surprising, extreme instance or boundary condition.

contrasts.analysis: 而且 merely adds complementary information on a parallel tier, whereas 甚至 introduces an unexpected, extreme escalation in degree.
甚至 is standard in spoken and written modern discourse, while 乃至 is formal, literary, and typically links nouns in an ascending series.
甚至 highlights escalating degree in the same logical direction, while 反而 expresses a twist contrary to expectation (contrary transition).

example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán de quánshuǐ bùjǐn zài gè dà míngshèng jǐngqū pēnyǒng, shènzhì zài xúncháng bǎixìng de sìhéyuàn yǔ jiēbiān shífèng jiān yě suíchù kějiàn.
example_sentences.en: Jinan's springs not only gush in major scenic parks, but can even be seen everywhere in ordinary courtyards and roadside stone crevices.
example_sentences.es: Los manantiales de Jinan no solo brotan en parques monumentales, sino que pueden verse incluso en patios vecinales corrientes y grietas de las calles.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该新能源电池在极端极寒测试中表现优异，在零下四十摄氏度的极冷环境下甚至仍能保持百分之八十五以上的容量输出。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi xīnnéngyuán diànchí zài jíduān jíhán cèshì zhōng biǎoxiàn yōuyì, zài língxià sìshí shèshìdù de jílěng huánjìng xià shènzhì réng néng bǎochí bǎifēnzhī bāshíwǔ yǐshàng de róngliàng shūchū.
example_sentences.en: This battery performed admirably in extreme freeze tests, even maintaining over 85% capacity output at minus forty degrees Celsius.
example_sentences.es: La batería rindió admirablemente en ensayos de frío extremo; a cuarenta grados bajo cero fue capaz incluso de conservar más del 85% de carga.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Savoring a sweet dish (甘) in a container with supreme delight carries enjoyment to an extreme (甚) degree.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Saborear un bocado dulce (甘) con deleite colma el placer hasta un grado extremo e insuperable (甚).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of an arrow (矢) shot from afar landing head-first into the soil (一), signifying arriving at the destination.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An arrow shot across the plains arrives and plants its tip into the earth to reach (至) the ultimate boundary.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una flecha disparada a lo lejos clava su punta en la tierra, alcanzando su destino final (至).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南泉水的魅力不仅在于其数量繁多，甚至在于它与城市百姓日常生活的无缝交融。漫步在古城区，家家户户门前泉水潺潺，居民用甘冽的泉水沏茶煮饭，甚至将西瓜浸在池中降温，构成了北方独特的市井画卷。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán quánshuǐ de mèilì bùjǐn zài yú qí shùliàng fánduō, shènzhì zài yú tā yǔ chéngshì bǎixìng rìcháng shēnghuó de wúfèng jiāoróng. Mànbù zài gǔchéngqū, jiājiāhùhù ménqián quánshuǐ chánchán, jūmín yòng gānliè de quánshuǐ qīchá zhǔfàn, shènzhì jiāng xīguā jìn zài chí zhōng jiàngwēn, gòuchéng le běifāng dútè de shìjǐng huàjuàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: The charm of Jinan's springs lies not merely in numbers, but even more in their seamless blend into daily life. Streams flow past every door, residents brew tea and cook with spring water, and even chill watermelons in pools.
extended_reading_passages.es: El encanto de Jinan no radica solo en sus manantiales, sino incluso en su íntima integración vecinal. El agua corre ante cada zaguán; los vecinos preparan té, guisan e incluso enfrían sandías en los estanques, pintando un cuadro costumbrista único.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 全球气候变暖引发的极端天气事件频发，甚至对传统地下水循环系统的稳定性构成了潜在威胁。水文科研部门通过构建全流域数值模型，对极端干旱情景下的泉水喷涌状态进行模拟预测，提前制定水资源战略储备方案。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Quánqiú qìhòu biànnuǎn yǐnfā de jíduān tiānqì shìjiàn pínfā, shènzhì duì chuántǒng dìxiàshuǐ xúnhuán xìtǒng de wěndìngxìng gòuchéng le qiánzài wēixié. Shuǐwén kěyán bùmén tōngguò gòujiàn quán liùyù shùzhí móxíng, duì jíduān gānhàn qíngjǐng xià de quánshuǐ pēnyǒng zhuàngtài jìnxíng mónǐ yùcè, tíqián zhìdìng shuǐ zīyuán zhànlüè chǔbèi fāng'àn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Extreme weather driven by global warming occurs frequently, even posing threats to groundwater circulation stability. Hydrologists build basin numerical models to simulate spring flows under drought, devising strategic reserve plans in advance.
extended_reading_passages.es: La crisis climática multiplica los fenómenos extremos, amenazando incluso la recarga de los acuíferos subterráneos. Los hidrólogos modelan cuencas para prever caudales en sequías graves, trazando reservas hídricas estratégicas.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 各种各样 emphasizes the rich multiplicity, diversity, and distinct varieties of physical objects, ideas, or methods.

contrasts.compared_word: 各种各样 vs. 形形色色
contrasts.analysis: 各种各样 is neutral and applies universally to objects, concepts, or phenomena, whereas 形形色色 often carries a skeptical or cautionary overtone when describing people or societal strata.

contrasts.compared_word: 各种各样 vs. 琳琅满目
contrasts.analysis: 各种各样 modifies any noun (problems, styles, goods), while 琳琅满目 specifically describes a dazzling visual array of beautiful treasures or premium merchandise.

contrasts.compared_word: 各种各样 vs. 五花八门
contrasts.analysis: 各种各样 describes positive or neutral multiplicity, while 五花八门 emphasizes dizzying heterogeneity, sometimes implying lack of cohesion or bewildering variety.

example_sentences.hanzi: 济南城内的七十二处名泉呈现出各种各样的奇妙姿态，有的如珍珠翻滚，有的如飞瀑倾泻。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán chéngnèi de qīshí'èr chù míngquán chéngxxiàn chū gèzhǒnggèyàng de qímiào zītài, yǒude rú zhēnzhū fāngǔn, yǒude rú fēipù qīngxiè.
example_sentences.en: The seventy-two famous springs of Jinan display all kinds of miraculous shapes, some churning like pearls, others tumbling like cascades.
example_sentences.es: Los setenta y dos manantiales célebres de Jinan muestran toda clase de posturas prodigiosas: unos hierven como perlas y otros caen en cascadas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了满足全球消费者的个性化需求，展会上展出了各种各样融合了现代设计与传统非遗的手工艺品。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile mǎnzú quánqiú xiāofèizhě de gèxìnghuà xūqiú, zhǎnhuì shàng zhǎnchū le gèzhǒnggèyàng rónghé le xiàndài shèjì yǔ chuántǒng fēiyí de shǒugōngyìpǐn.
example_sentences.en: To satisfy global consumers' personalized demands, the expo showcased diverse handicrafts fusing modern design with traditional heritage.
example_sentences.es: Para satisfacer las demandas personalizadas, la feria expuso toda índole de artesanías que fusionan el diseño contemporáneo con el patrimonio vivo.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Different people walking (夂) arrive each voicing separate opinions with their mouths (口), showing variety (各).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Diversas personas que caminan (夂) expresan con su boca (口) pareceres distintos, reflejando diversidad (各).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where grain radical 禾 indicates botanical cultivated varieties and seeds.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Harvested sheaves of grain (禾) centered (中) in the field represent distinct agricultural species and types (种).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Gavillas de cereal (禾) seleccionadas en el centro (中) representan diversas especies y variedades (种).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound where tree radical 木 indicates carved wooden molds and templates.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un molde de madera (木) tallado con la figura de un carnero (羊) sirve de patrón o modelo (样).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫步在古城济南的泉池之间，你会惊叹于大自然的神奇造化。这里汇聚了各种各样的名泉，有的如沸水般喷涌而出，有的如珍珠般串串升腾，还有的在青石绿柳间宛转低回，交织成一幅动静相宜的水乡长卷。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànbù zài gǔchéng Jǐnán de quánchí zhījiān, nǐ huì jīngtàn yú dàzìrán de shénqí zàohuà. Zhèlǐ huìjù le gèzhǒnggèyàng de míngquán, yǒude rú fèishuǐ bān pēnyǒng ér chū, yǒude rú zhēnzhū bān chuànchuàn shēngténg, háiyǒu de zài qīngshí lǜliǔ jiān wǎnzhuǎn dīhuí, jiāozhī chéng yì fú dòngjìng xiāngyí de shuǐxiāng chángjuàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Strolling among ancient Jinan's spring pools, one marvels at nature's artistry. Here gather all kinds of springs: some gush like boiling water, some ascend like pearls, and others murmur gently between rocks and willows.
extended_reading_passages.es: Paseando entre los manantiales de la histórica Jinan, admira el prodigio de la naturaleza. Aquí concurre toda clase de veneros: unos hierven impetuosos, otros ascienden como perlas y otros susurran entre sauces y piedras.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 为了应对全球市场多元化的消费需求，跨境电商平台汇集了来自世界各地的各种各样特色商品。通过大数据智能算法与柔性供应链支持，平台能够快速响应不同区域市场的偏好变化，大幅提升了国际贸易流通效率。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèile yīngduì quánqiú shìchǎng duōyuánhuà de xiāofèi xūqiú, kuàjìng diànshāng píngtái huìjí le láizì shìjiè gèdì de gèzhǒnggèyàng tèsè shāngpǐn. Tōngguò dàshùjù zhìnéng suànfǎ yǔ róuxìng gōngyìngliàn zhīchí, píngtái nénggòu kuàisù xiǎngyìng bùtóng qūyù shìchǎng de piānhào biànhuà, dàfú tíshēng le guójì màoyì liútōng xiàolǜ.
extended_reading_passages.en: To address diversified global demand, cross-border e-commerce platforms gather diverse specialty goods from across the world. Big-data algorithms and agile supply chains enable rapid responses to preferences, boosting trade circulation.
extended_reading_passages.es: Para responder a la demanda global diversa, el comercio electrónico transfronterizo congrega toda suerte de artículos típicos del orbe. Algoritmos inteligentes y cadenas ágiles optimizan la respuesta a tendencias, agilizando el flujo comercial internacional.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A framed contour (形) and the alert posture of a dog (状) together define the visible physical shape of an object.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un contorno perfilado (形) y la noble estampa de un can (状) definen la forma externa de un objeto.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese ontology, 'xíng' is the material boundary and physical envelope, while 'zhuàng' describes the dynamic outward posture or manifested condition.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'xíng' (35) followed by falling 4th tone 'zhuàng' (51). Clear contrast from rising to falling pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 形状 refers specifically to the external spatial outline, geometric silhouette, or bodily contour of a physical entity.

contrasts.analysis: 形状 refers to external physical or geometric contour, whereas 状态 describes an ongoing internal condition, mood, or operational state (工作状态).
形状 is formal and strictly denotes spatial geometry, while 样子 is colloquial and can encompass facial expressions, manners, or general style.
形状 applies to tangible, concrete spatial outlines, whereas 形式 refers to abstract organizational formats, modalities, or artistic genres.

senses.definition_en: the external spatial contour, form, or physical appearance of an object
senses.definition_es: figura, forma exterior, perfil o configuración de un objeto
senses.example_phrase: 泉池的形状各不相同 (the shapes of the spring pools are each different)

example_sentences.hanzi: 济南的泉池形状各异，有的大如明镜湖泊，有的小若茶盏石盂，在青翠垂柳映衬下各具韵味。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán de quánchí xíngzhuàng gè yì, yǒude dà rú míngjìng húpō, yǒude xiǎo ruò cházhǎn shíyú, zài qīngcuì chuíliǔ yìngchèn xià gè jù yùnwèi.
example_sentences.en: The spring pools of Jinan vary in shape; some are as vast as glassy lakes, others small as stone teacups, each possessing distinct charm.
example_sentences.es: Las pozas de los manantiales de Jinan varían de forma: unas son amplias como espejos de agua y otras diminutas como cuencos, todas llenas de encanto.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该实验室通过高精度三维扫描技术，对古生物化石的几何形状与微观结构进行了数字化复原。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi shíyànshì tōngguò gāojīngdù sānwéi sǎomiáo jìshù, duì gǔshēngwù huàshí de jǐhé xíngzhuàng yǔ wēiguān jiégòu jìnxíng le shùzìhuà fùyuán.
example_sentences.en: The laboratory digitally reconstructed the geometric shapes and microstructures of prehistoric fossils using high-precision 3D scanning.
example_sentences.es: El laboratorio reconstruyó digitalmente la forma geométrica y microestructura de fósiles prehistóricos mediante escaneo tridimensional de alta precisión.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fine aesthetic brushstrokes (彡) painted upon an open wooden frame (开) give it a defined visual shape (形).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trazos finos de pincel (彡) dibujados sobre una estructura abierta (开) le confieren una hermosa forma (形).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A loyal hunting dog (犬) sitting alert beside a wooden stand (丬) presents a proud physical posture and shape (状).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un leal can (犬) sentado junto a un pedestal (丬) muestra una estampa imponente y noble figura (状).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南泉水的奇妙，很大程度上在于泉池形状的变幻万千。有的泉池方方正正如汉玉石印，有的则蜿蜒曲折如天然溪谷。微风吹过水面，泉水随池池形状荡漾出层层清波，与岸边的石阶小桥融为一体。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán quánshuǐ de qímiào, hěn dà chéngdù shàng zàiyú quánchí xíngzhuàng de biànhuàn wànqiān. Yǒude quánchí fāngfāngzhèngzhèng rú hànyù shíyìn, yǒude zé wānyán qūzhé rú tiānrán xīgǔ. Wēifēng chuīguò shuǐmiàn, quánshuǐ suí chí xíngzhuàng dàngyàng chū céngcéng qīngbō, yǔ ànbiān de shíjiē xiǎoqiáo róng wéi yītǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: The wonder of Jinan's springs largely stems from the infinite variety of pool shapes. Some are square like jade seals, others meander like natural gorges. Wind ripples waves conforming to pool contours, blending with stone bridges.
extended_reading_passages.es: El encanto de Jinan proviene de la variada forma de sus pozas. Unas son cuadradas como sellos de jade; otras serpentean como cañones naturales. El viento riza las aguas adaptadas a cada contorno, en armonía con los puentes de piedra.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在航空航天空气动力学设计中，飞行器外形形状的微小改动都会对升阻比产生决定性影响。工程师运用超算平台进行流体动力学仿真，反复优化机翼曲面形状，力求在超音速飞行时最大程度减小阻力并提升燃油效率。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài hángkōng hángtiān kōngqì dònglìxué shèjì zhōng, fēixíngqì wàixíng xíngzhuàng de wēixiǎo gǎidòng dōu huì duì shēngzǔbǐ chǎnshēng juédìngxìng yǐngxiǎng. Gōngchéngshī yùnyòng chāosuàn píngtái jìnxíng liútǐ dònglìxué fǎngzhēn, fǎnfù yōuhuà jīyì qūmiàn xíngzhuàng, lìqiú zài chāoyīnsù fēixíng shí zuìdà chéngdù jiǎnxiǎo zǔlì bìng tíshēng rányóu xiàolǜ.
extended_reading_passages.en: In aerodynamic aerospace design, minor alterations to an aircraft's external shape decisively affect lift-to-drag ratios. Engineers run fluid simulations on supercomputers, optimizing wing contours to minimize supersonic drag and boost fuel efficiency.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el diseño aeroespacial aerodinámico, el menor cambio en la forma exterior altera decisivamente la sustentación. Ingenieros simulan fluidos por supercomputación, afinando curvaturas alares para minimizar la resistencia supersónica y ahorrar combustible.

meanings_summary.en: lively; vivid; graphic; full of life and vitality
meanings_summary.es: vivo; vívido; animado; gráfico; lleno de vitalidad

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Fresh life sprouting from soil (生) set into kinetic motion by strength (动) produces a vivid and lively reality.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La vida que brota de la tierra (生) impulsada por la fuerza (动) engendra una realidad vívida y animada.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese art criticism (六法), 'qìyùn shēngdòng' (气韵生动 - spiritual vitality and lively resonance) is the supreme canon of aesthetic excellence, requiring artworks to pulsate with living rhythm.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'shēng' (55) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'dòng' (51). Clean transition from level to dropping pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 生动 describes narratives, depictions, artistic expressions, or visual scenes that are lively, vivid, and full of natural vitality.

contrasts.analysis: 生动 describes speeches, writings, artistic depictions, or visual spectacles, whereas 活泼 describes bubbly personality, children, or casual lively atmospheres.
生动 highlights emotional vitality, expressive resonance, and lively spirit, while 逼真 emphasizes strict visual verisimilitude and photographic fidelity.
生动 stresses kinetic vitality and engaging expressiveness, whereas 形象 means graphic, concrete, or functioning as a tangible metaphor.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 文 variant on top, whereas 生 is a pure pictographic shoot
Has 幺 (tiny) next to 力 instead of 云 in 动
Has 去 (go) next to 力 instead of 云
Has 又 (again) next to 力 instead of 云

senses.definition_en: possessing vibrant vitality, rich visual expression, or engaging narrative energy
senses.definition_es: vivo; animado; lleno de dinamismo y expresividad gráfica
senses.example_phrase: 生动的画面 (a vivid scene)

example_sentences.hanzi: 趵突泉池底翻滚冒泡的泉花此起彼伏，如群鱼戏水，呈现出一幅极其生动自然的动态画卷。
example_sentences.pinyin: Bàotūquán chídǐ fāngǔn màopào de quánhuā cǐqǐbǐfú, rú qúnyú xìshuǐ, chéngxiàn chū yì fú jíqí shēngdòng zìrán de dòngtài huàjuàn.
example_sentences.en: Bubbling plumes at Baotu Spring rise one after another like playful fish, presenting an extraordinarily vivid and natural moving tapestry.
example_sentences.es: Las burbujas que borbotan en el manantial Baotu emergen sin cesar como peces jugando, ofreciendo una estampa dinámica, viva y natural.

example_sentences.hanzi: 教授用生动幽默的事例深入浅出地讲解枯燥的经济学原理，赢得了全场学生的热烈掌声。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshòu yòng shēngdòng yōumò de shìlì shēnrùqiǎnchū de jiǎngjiě kūzào de jīngjìxué yuánlǐ, yíngdé le quánchǎng xuéshēng de rèliè zhǎngshēng.
example_sentences.en: The professor used vivid, humorous real-life anecdotes to explain dry economic principles simply, winning enthusiastic applause.
example_sentences.es: El profesor recurrió a ejemplos vívidos y amenos para explicar con llaneza arduos principios económicos, cosechando calurosos aplausos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南的泉水不仅形态万千，更因其永不停歇的喷涌而显得格外生动。泉水翻滚时激起的浪花与水雾，在青石与古柳间流淌成灵动的画卷。漫步其间，你能真切感受到大自然赋予这座古老城市的勃勃生机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán de quánshuǐ bùjǐn xíngtài wànqiān, gèng yīn qí yǒng bù tíngxiē de pēnyǒng ér xiǎnde géwài shēngdòng. Quánshuǐ fāngǔn shí jīqǐ de lànghuā yǔ shuǐwù, zài qīngshí yǔ gǔliǔ jiān liútǎng chéng língdòng de huàjuàn. Mànbù qíjiān, nǐ néng zhēnqiè gǎnshòu dào dàzìrán fùyǔ zhè zuò gǔlǎo chéngshì de bóbó shēngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Jinan's springs are not only manifold in form, but appear exceptionally vivid through endless surging. Splashing plumes and mist flow between rocks and willows like a living tapestry, showcasing nature's vibrant vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los manantiales de Jinan no solo asombran por sus mil formas, sino que lucen vivaces por su borbotar perenne. Espumas y brumas fluyen entre sauces y piedras como un tapiz vivo que irradia la pujante energía de la naturaleza.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在数字媒体艺术创作中，三维实时渲染引擎为文化遗产的数字化重现提供了生动逼真的视觉表现力。通过精确模拟真实光影与水流粒子动力学，古代名泉的喷涌奇观得以在虚拟展馆中重获新生，吸引了年轻受众。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shùzì méitǐ yìshù chuàngzuò zhōng, sānwéi shíshí xuànrǎn yǐnqíng wèi wénhuà yíchǎn de shùzìhuà chóngxiàn tígōng le shēngdòng bīzhēn de shìjué biǎoxiànlì. Tōngguò jīngquè mónǐ zhēnshí guāngyǐng yǔ shuǐliú lìzǐ dònglìxué, gǔdài míngquán de pēnyǒng qíguān déyǐ zài xūnǐ zhǎnguǎn zhōng chónghuò xīnshēng, xīyǐn le niánqīng shòuzhòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In digital media arts, 3D real-time rendering engines render cultural heritage with vivid, lifelike fidelity. Accurately simulating fluid dynamics, ancient springs revive in virtual galleries, engaging younger audiences.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la creación digital interactiva, los motores 3D aportan un dinamismo visual vivo y realista al patrimonio. Al simular la hidrodinámica y luces con precisión, los antiguos manantiales renacen virtualmente seduciendo al público joven.

meanings_summary.en: to name; to christen; to designate; to give a name to
meanings_summary.es: nombrar; bautizar; denominar; dar nombre a; titular

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An official decree (命) uttered to proclaim someone's title (名) formally names and designates them.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un decreto formal (命) proclamado para otorgar un título (名) bautiza y designa con solemnidad.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese epistemology (正名思想 - rectification of names), 'mìngmíng' is an ontological act where language confers order upon natural chaos, aligning names with cosmic principles.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone 'mìng' (51) followed by rising 2nd tone 'míng' (35). Clean drop from 51 followed by a smooth upward glide to 35.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 命名 is a formal transitive verb signifying the deliberate, official conferring of a name, title, or scientific designation.

contrasts.analysis: 命名 is formal, institutional, or scientific (naming astronomical bodies, landmarks, treaties), whereas 起名 is colloquial (naming a baby, pet, or informal nickname).
命名 denotes the single, formal act of bestowing a title, whereas 称为 is the descriptive state of being called or referred to by that title over time.
命名 is elevated and refers to formal christening, whereas 叫作 simply states what an object or person is called in daily conversation.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the mouth radical 口 on top of 命
Has open ribs on top, unrelated to 命
Has 夂 (walk) over 口, whereas 名 has 夕 over 口
Has 夂 over 口 instead of 夕

senses.definition_en: to formally bestow a name, designation, or title upon a person, place, entity, or scientific discovery
senses.definition_es: otorgar formalmente un nombre, denominación o título a una persona, paraje, entidad o hallazgo científico
senses.example_phrase: 以传说命名泉水 (name springs after legends)

example_sentences.hanzi: 济南的七十二处名泉大多根据其喷涌的水势、形状或动人的历史传说而命名。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnán de qīshí'èr chù míngquán dàduō gēnjù qí pēnyǒng de shuǐshì, xíngzhuàng huò dòngrén de lìshǐ chuánshuō ér mìngmíng.
example_sentences.en: Most of Jinan's seventy-two famous springs were named after their gushing water momentum, shapes, or touching historical legends.
example_sentences.es: La mayoría de los setenta y dos manantiales célebres de Jinan fueron bautizados según la fuerza de su caudal, su forma o leyendas históricas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 国际天文学联合会正式将该颗由中国天文学家新发现的小行星命名为“屠呦呦星”，以表彰其卓越的医学贡献。
example_sentences.pinyin: Guójì tiānwénxué liánhéhuì zhèngshì jiāng gāi kē yóu Zhōngguó tiānwénxuéjiā xīn fāxiàn de xiǎoxíngxīng mìngmíng wéi "Tú Yōuyōu Xīng", yǐ biǎozhāng qí zhuóyuè de yīxué gòngxiàn.
example_sentences.en: The International Astronomical Union formally named the newly discovered asteroid "Tu Youyou" to honor her outstanding medical contributions.
example_sentences.es: La Unión Astronómica Internacional bautizó oficialmente un asteroide recién descubierto como "Tu Youyou", premiando sus aportaciones médicas.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining 口 (mouth) issuing an official decree 令, signifying a supreme mandate or designation.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An official authority speaks with his mouth (口) to issue an authoritative command (令) conferring a title or destiny (命).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una autoridad proclama con la boca (口) un solemne mandato (令) para conferir un nombre o destino (命).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: In nighttime darkness (夕), people had to proclaim their identity with their mouths (口) so others could recognize them.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: As darkness falls in the evening (夕), call out your identifier with your mouth (口) to proclaim your name (名).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Al caer la noche (夕), proclamas con la boca (口) tu identidad para dar a conocer tu nombre (名).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 济南名泉的命名极具文化底蕴。黑虎泉因水声轰鸣如虎啸而得名，珍珠泉因串串水泡晶莹如珠而命名。每一处泉水名称的背后，都凝结着古代百姓对大自然鬼斧神工的赞美，以及流传千载的美丽传说。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnán míngquán de mìngmíng jí jù wénhuà dǐyùn. Hēihǔquán yīn shuǐshēng hōngmíng rú hǔxiào ér dé míng, Zhēnzhūquán yīn chuànchuàn shuǐpào jīngyíng rú zhū ér mìngmíng. Měi yí chù quánshuǐ míngchēng de bèihòu, dōu níngjié zhe gǔdài bǎixìng duì dàzìrán guǐfǔshéngōng de zànměi, yǐjí liúchuán qiānzǎi de měilì chuánshuō.
extended_reading_passages.en: The naming of Jinan's famous springs is steeped in culture. Black Tiger Spring was named for its roaring water like a tiger; Pearl Spring was christened for bead-like bubbles. Each name crystallizes admiration for nature and legends.
extended_reading_passages.es: El bautismo de los manantiales de Jinan destila hondo arraigo cultural. El Tigre Negro debe su nombre al rugido del agua; el de las Perlas fue bautizado por sus burbujas perladas. Cada nombre condensa el asombro popular y leyendas milenarias.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在地理信息系统建设中，地名标准化命名是规范城乡治理与历史文脉保护的基础工作。民政地名管理部门在为新建道路和公共建筑命名时，广泛征求历史学家意见，积极融入本土历史元素，守护城市文化根脉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ xìnxī xìtǒng jiànshè zhōng, dìmíng biāozhǔnhuà mìngmíng shì guīfàn chéngxiāng zhìlǐ yǔ lìshǐ wénmài bǎohù de jīchǔ gōngzuò. Mínzhèng dìmíng guǎnlǐ bùmén zài wèi xīnjiàn dàolù hé gōnggòng jiànzhù mìngmíng shí, guǎnfàn zhēngqiú lìshǐxuéjiā yìjiàn, jījí róngrù běntǔ lìshǐ yuánsù, shǒuhù chéngshì wénhuà gēnmài.
extended_reading_passages.en: In GIS development, standardized naming is foundational to urban governance and cultural conservation. When naming new streets and public facilities, civil affairs bureaus consult historians to weave local heritage into civic identity.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los sistemas de información geográfica, la toponimia estandarizada es básica para la gobernanza urbana. Al denominar vías y edificios públicos, las autoridades consultan a historiadores para preservar las raíces culturales de la urbe.

meanings_summary.en: wide; vast; broad; expansive; spacious
meanings_summary.es: amplio; vasto; extenso; anchuroso; espacioso

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Step out from under the roof (广) into open gates where fresh water flows (阔) to behold a vast expansive horizon.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Sal del alero (广) hacia los portales abiertos al agua viva (阔) para contemplar un horizonte amplio y vasto.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical spatial perception, 'guǎng' denotes east-to-west horizontal breadth, while 'kuò' denotes open distance, together conceptualizing infinite physical space and open-minded philosophical perspective.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'guǎng' (214) followed by sharp falling 4th tone 'kuò' (51). Clear contrast from low dip to sharp drop.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 广阔 emphasizes expansive horizontal land/water surfaces, boundless panoramas, or broad figurative prospects.

contrasts.analysis: 广阔 refers to vast two-dimensional expanses (广阔的草原, 广阔的湖面, 广阔的市场), whereas 宽阔 describes linear breadth, such as wide roads or broad shoulders (宽阔的马路).
广阔 can describe both physical spaces and abstract prospects/markets, while 辽阔 is strictly reserved for boundless natural terrains like immense oceans, steppes, or skies.
广阔 describes physical space or market scope, while 广博 specifically describes depth and breadth of human knowledge and academic erudition.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the top dot stroke of 广
Has stone radical 石 next to 广
Has 市 (market) inside 门 instead of 活
Has 才 inside 门 instead of 活

senses.definition_en: vast in spatial extent, breadth of vision, or scope of prospects
senses.definition_es: amplio; vasto; de gran extensión territorial, visión o perspectiva
senses.example_phrase: 广阔的天地 (a vast world / broad horizon)

example_sentences.hanzi: 汇聚了无数清泉的大明湖水面十分广阔，波光粼粼，岸边万千垂柳随风轻拂。
example_sentences.pinyin: Huìjù le wúshù qīngquán de Dàmíng Hú shuǐmiàn shífēn guǎngkuò, bōguāng línlín, ànbiān wànqiān chuíliǔ suífēng qīngfú.
example_sentences.en: The surface of Daming Lake, where countless pure springs converge, is exceptionally vast, with sparkling waves and willows swaying.
example_sentences.es: La superficie del lago Daming, donde confluyen incontables manantiales, es muy vasta y centelleante, rodeada de sauces que se mecen.

example_sentences.hanzi: 新一轮科技革命和产业变革正在加速演进，为人工智能与绿色能源产业开辟了极其广阔的市场空间。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xīn yì lún kējì gémìng hé chǎnyè biàngé zhèngzài jiāsù yǎnjìn, wèi réngōng zhìnéng yǔ lǜsè néngyuán chǎnyè kāipì le jíqí guǎngkuò de shìchǎng kōngjiān.
example_sentences.en: A new wave of technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating, opening vast market space for AI and green energy.
example_sentences.es: Una nueva ola de revolución tecnológica e industrial se acelera, abriendo un amplísimo horizonte de mercado a la IA y a la energía verde.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under a vast hall's open roof (广), boundless space stretches outward in every direction to embrace the world.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo la amplia nave techada (广), se abre un espacio inmenso que abarca horizontes sin fin.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When the courtyard gates (门) swing wide open to living running waters (活), the landscape appears profoundly vast (阔).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Al abrir de par en par los portales (门) al agua viva (活), el paisaje se ensancha en un panorama vasto (阔).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 登上超然楼极目远眺，大明湖广阔的水面尽收眼底。浩渺的水波倒映着远处的千佛山与蓝天白云，湖畔垂柳依依，画舫穿梭其间。这片广阔的水域如同大自然赐予泉城的一面明镜，涵养着整座城市的诗性与灵气。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dēng shàng Chāorán Lóu jímù yuǎntiào, Dàmíng Hú guǎngkuò de shuǐmiàn jìn shōu yǎndǐ. Hàomiǎo de shuǐbō dàoyìng zhe yuǎnchù de Qiānfó Shān yǔ lántiān báiyún, húpàn chuíliǔ yīyī, huàfǎng chuānsuō qíjiān. Zhè piàn guǎngkuò de shuǐyù rútóng dàzìrán cìyǔ Quánchéng de yí miàn míngjìng, hányǎng zhe zhěng zuò chéngshì de shīxìng yǔ língqì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Climbing Chaoran Tower to gaze far, Daming Lake's vast waters unfold before the eye. Vast waves mirror distant Thousand Buddha Mountain; pleasure boats cruise by weeping willows. This expanse acts as a mirror nurturing the city's spirit.
extended_reading_passages.es: Desde la torre Chaoran, la vasta lámina de agua del lago Daming cautiva la mirada. Las aguas reflejan montes y cielos; los barcos navegan entre sauces. Esta vasta superficie es un espejo natural que nutre el alma poética de la urbe.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 全球数字经济的高速发展，为传统制造业数字化转型拓展了极其广阔的应用场景。领军企业通过建设工业互联网平台，实现全要素设备互联与全产业链数据协同，在广阔的国际竞争舞台上抢占价值链制高点。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Quánqiú shùzì jīngjì de gāosù fāzhǎn, wèi chuántǒng zhìzàoyè shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng tuòzhǎn le jíqí guǎngkuò de yìngyòng chǎngjǐng. Lǐngjūn qǐyè tōngguò jiànshè gōngyè hùliánwǎng píngtái, shíxiàn quán yàosù shèbèi hùlián yǔ quán chǎnyèliàn shùjù xiétóng, zài guǎngkuò de guójì jìngzhēng wǔtái shàng qiǎngzhàn jiàzhíliàn zhìgāodiǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Rapid digital economy expansion broadens expansive applications for traditional manufacturing. Leading firms deploy industrial IoT platforms to interconnect machinery and data, securing competitive advantages across vast global markets.
extended_reading_passages.es: El auge de la economía digital abre vastos horizontes a la manufactura tradicional. Las corporaciones punteras implantan plataformas de internet industrial para interconectar procesos y datos, liderando la cadena de valor global.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Pure spring water (氵) gathered within a curved stone basin (也) creates an emerald spring pool (池).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Agua pura de manantial (氵) recogida en una pila de piedra (也) forma una alberca (池) esmeralda.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical architecture, garden pools ('chí') are not merely hydraulic reservoirs, but cosmological focal points capturing the sky's reflection and circulating yin qi.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'chí' (35). Smooth upward pitch contour without truncation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 池 specifically denotes an enclosed, excavated, or walled body of still or bubbling water (natural or man-made pool).

contrasts.analysis: 池 is a relatively small, often stone-banked pool or garden pond, whereas 湖 is a vast, natural or grand artificial lake (e.g. 大明湖).
池 emphasizes horizontal enclosure and clear banks, while 潭 emphasizes profound vertical depth and dark abyss (e.g. 黑龙潭).
池 is an open, shallow pool exposed to open air, while 井 is a deep, narrow vertical bore drilled downward into bedrock.

Has person radical 亻 on the left instead of water 氵
